title: Pale roof top texture
where: roof deck y6, whole footprint x2..16 z2..12
instruction: The mix has light tuff/basalt patches that read as a checker from above. Edit the roof() call in build.mjs: material mix [[polished_blackstone_brick,60],[cobbled_deepslate,25],[smooth_basalt,15]] and re-run `mcd roof build.nbt --spec roof.json --dry-run` (keep >=3 tones, no warnings), then node build.mjs.

title: Thin the roof fascia
instruction: The roof reads as a heavy 2-course lid; the concept fascia is one slim course. Try roof option `fascia` with a slab-height edge (see references/roofs.md) or drop the extra top course; compare front-right.png before/after and keep the better.

title: Big glass facade check
where: front wall x4..6 y2..4 and west wall z5..9
instruction: Add steel mullions: `mcd paint` rule `north openings -> glazing grid frame black_concrete every 3` (and the same for the west face) so the glass reads as a framed steel curtain wall.

title: Interior menu board
where: east interior wall x13, z6-7, y3-4
instruction: Place a black chalkboard: 2x2 black_concrete with a spruce_trapdoor frame (open) and B.sign('oak',['MENU','COFFEE','TEA','CAKE'],{facing:'west',color:'white'}) on it.

title: Terrace umbrellas / pergola lanterns
instruction: Chain + lantern pendants from the roof soffit above the front tables (x2,x5 at z=3: iron_chain y4, lantern hanging y3 is too low, so use y4 lantern hanging directly under y5 soffit).

title: Door fixtures
where: either side of the double door x7 and x10, y3, z3
instruction: `mcd paint` rule `north rows 2-4 -> fixtures at doors` or B.lantern wall brackets (stairs top + lantern) so the entrance has two warm lights.

title: Steps handrail
instruction: Add 1-high polished_blackstone_wall rails on both sides of the steps at x6 and x11 (z0..1), joined to the screen posts.

title: Back wall service details
where: back wall z=10 and overhang z11-12
instruction: Add a vent: B.trapdoor('iron' style via spruce/dark) louvres 2x2 at x4-5 y3-4 on the back, a wall lantern by the service door at x11,y3,z11, and a hanging B.sign('spruce',['STAFF','ONLY']) at the door.

title: Terrace west hedge shape
instruction: The hedges are 2x2 leaf cubes: stagger heights (y3 and y4) and add a vine or two (B.block('vine') with facing) so they read as ivy columns rather than boxes.

title: Paving pattern
where: terrace deck y1, z1..3 and x1..2 z4..11
instruction: Extend the stone/andesite checker to the west strip and add a smooth_stone border row 1 inside the plinth ring.
